categories.main_business_segments: Graphic Packaging Holding Company operates three reportable segments: Paperboard Mills (seven North American mills producing CRB, CUK, and SBS paperboard), Americas Paperboard Packaging (folding cartons and foodservice products for CPG and QSR customers in the Americas), and Europe Paperboard Packaging (folding cartons for CPG companies in Europe). The company is a leading fiber-based consumer packaging provider serving beverage, food, foodservice, and consumer products markets globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company manufactures coated recycled paperboard (CRB), coated unbleached kraft paperboard (CUK), and solid bleached sulfate paperboard (SBS) using virgin and recycled fibers. Core technologies include proprietary carton designs, active microwave packaging technology, barrier protection packaging, and specialized packaging machinery for bottles and cans. Manufacturing processes utilize continuous improvement methodologies including Lean Six Sigma and statistical process control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include multinational beverage companies (Anheuser-Busch, MillerCoors, PepsiCo, Coca-Cola), food companies (Kraft Heinz, General Mills, Nestlé, Kellogg), quick-service restaurants (Chick-fil-A, McDonald's, Wendy's), and health/beauty companies (GlaxoSmithKline, Bayer, Johnson & Johnson, Procter & Gamble). End markets include beverage, food, prepared food and drinks, household products, air filter frames, and health and beauty.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with converting plants and one paper mill in 21 countries outside the U.S., including operations in Europe, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Mexico, Japan, and other regions. As of 2022, approximately 29% of net sales came from operations outside the U.S., and approximately 29% of total assets were denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar. Approximately 67% of employees are in the Americas and 33% in Europe and rest of world.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the supply chain as an integrated fiber-based packaging provider. It operates upstream with seven paperboard mills producing CRB, CUK, and SBS, midstream with converting operations that transform paperboard into finished cartons and containers, and downstream with specialized packaging machinery manufacturing and installation. Approximately 73.4% of combined mill production is consumed internally in converting operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding market share through organic growth and acquisitions, developing innovative fiber-based packaging solutions to replace plastic, extending product shelf life, reducing production and waste costs, and enhancing heat-managing characteristics. R&D focuses on consumer-led sustainability trends, circular packaging solutions, and developing proprietary technologies. The company invests in capability development through GPI University and continuous improvement initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of paperboard and converted packaging products (cartons, containers, cups, lids) sold to CPG companies, foodservice providers, and QSR customers under annual and multi-year supply contracts. Revenue is recognized when control of products transfers to customers, typically upon shipment. The company also sells excess paperboard production to external converters and brokers in the open market.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include WestRock Company (primary CUK competitor in the U.S.), Klabin Company (Brazil), and Stora Enso (Sweden). The company is the largest North American producer of CRB, one of the largest North American producers of SBS, and the largest of four worldwide producers of CUK. The company holds leading market positions and competes on price, strength, printability, quality, service, and sustainability benefits.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a large accelerated filer with 2022 net sales of $9,440 million (32% increase from $7,156 million in 2021), income from operations of $906 million (123% increase from $407 million in 2021), and net income of $522 million. The company had approximately 24,000 employees across 130 locations in 26 countries as of December 31, 2022. Total debt was $5,283 million as of December 31, 2022, with a market capitalization of approximately $6.3 billion as of June 30, 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through proprietary carton designs, active microwave technologies, barrier protection capabilities, and convenience features (easy opening, pour spouts, sealable liners). Key value propositions include superior printability for high-resolution graphics, strength and durability for shipping and display, recyclability advantages over plastic alternatives, and integrated mill-to-converting solutions. The company emphasizes sustainability, offering fiber-based alternatives to plastic packaging and circular packaging solutions aligned with consumer environmental concerns.
